title: Midwrite discovery report, schema 1

value.description: A model value (midwrite_model::value::Value, untagged): null, boolean, 64-bit integer, string, a list, or an object. Objects are rows and the tagged forms {"$generated": n, "actor": a, "n": k}, {"$undefined": true}, {"$map": [[key, value], ...]} and {"$set": [item, ...]}, all of which are objects whose members are values. There are no floating-point values.

origin.description: Where a property comes from; never upgraded by a later step.

verdict.description: The model checker's verdict; NOT_LOADED when the synthesized scenario does not load.

val.description: Where a value comes from (midwrite_discover::effects::Val, tagged by `kind`).

term.description: An invariant term (midwrite_model::invariant::Term): an integer, a string, null, or one operator. Phase 16 adds countMatching, rowMatching, returned, field and argument.

formula.description: An invariant formula (midwrite_model::invariant::Formula): exactly one operator. Phase 16 adds generatedBy, sameGenerated, distinctGenerated, same, forEachActor and forEachRow (docs/phase16/GENERATED-ID-INVARIANTS.md).

spec.description: A property template before instantiation (tagged by `template`; the fields of a template keep their Rust snake_case names).

kind.description: `foreign-key-locks` was stated by Phase 12 producers only (with origin `model-limitation`); Phase 13 models foreign-key locks and no longer states it. `loop`, `caught-error` and `request` (origin `source-derived`) are Phase 16: a loop's unrolling classification (`loop BOUNDED_UNROLLING|TRUNCATED|UNKNOWN|UNSUPPORTED|COMPLETED at file:line:col ...`), how caught database errors are shaped, and the request-body assumptions of a route handler.

formula.description: Debug rendering of the formula (text, not a structure).

algorithm.description: Empty when the scenario did not load.

worldInfo.description: Phase 15: the initial world of a scenario (present only when world search is on, --max-worlds > 1).

sourceVerification.description: Whether `midwrite model-check <file> --verify-source --allow-execution` can run the scenario against the original code.

coverage.description: Phase 15: the input, schedule, branch and source dimensions of a model-checked candidate.

domainExhaustive.description: Never true: synthesized inputs never enumerate a value domain.

nextStep.description: Phase 14 (always present from Phase 14 on): what a developer can do next.

budgets.description: Budgets and counters. The five world counters (Phase 15) are present together or not at all; see `anyOf` at the top level.

actorSel.description: Phase 16 (midwrite_model::invariant::ActorSel): the bound actor of an enclosing forEachActor, an actor by name, or the actors of a function.

generatorSel.description: Phase 16 (GeneratorSel): values generated by package calls, or by a column's default.

rowMatch.description: Phase 16 (RowMatch): rows of `table` matching literal `where` values and term-valued `match` values, optionally inserted by an actor.

name.description: The producing tool: `midwrite`, or `commitrift` for reports written before the rename (2026-11-04).

anyOf.description: Phase 11-13 producers: no `nextStep`, no Phase 15 coverage, worlds or world counters.
Phase 14 producers: every candidate has `nextStep`; no Phase 15 coverage, worlds or world counters.
Phase 15 and later producers: the five world counters in `budgets`, `nextStep` on every candidate; `coverage` (with --model-check) and `world` (with world search) when applicable.

description: Phase 16: the first published schema of `midwrite discover --format json` (kind commitrift.discovery, schemaVersion 1). Schema version 1 was extended additively by Phase 14 (`nextStep`) and Phase 15 (`coverage`, `world`, world counters in `budgets`) without a version change; the top-level `anyOf` accepts exactly these three generations and rejects mixtures (a world counter without the others, `coverage` without `nextStep`). Any other `schemaVersion` is rejected. See docs/phase16/QUALITY-GATES.md.
